title: feat(install): a declared dependency co-owns its parent's namespace, and both boot hydrates sort by it (ADR-0141 D5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XJ5XLtgWVaBQg2nkK9T9j9j)_

Part of #25792

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## Summary

ADR-0141 D5, card items 4 and 5, plus the two review notes from #25986.

**Item 4: a declared dependency is a second co-owner source** (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`). `SchemaRegistry.installPackage` builds one co-owner map, `coOwnersOf`, and both halves of the ADR-0130 D3 pair read it: the namespace gate and `refuseCoOwnedObjectNameCollision`. For a non-shareable namespace N used by the incoming package P, the map holds:

- `artifact`: the artifact's other packages, exactly as before;
- `dependency`: an installed X that P declares and that holds N, or a sitting owner of N that declares P. This is the same relation read from the other end, so an upgrade or reinstall of the app beside its modules, or a boot that hydrated a module first, is admitted;
- `sibling`: a sitting owner S of N, when S and P each directly declare one installed package that holds N.

Only direct declarations count. The shared parent's namespace is read from its installed record, so two packages that declare one common package co-own nothing unless that package is installed and holds N.

`ArtifactObjectNameConflictError` keeps `DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_OBJECT_NAME` / 422. Its message is now worded per source (same artifact, declared dependency, sibling), so a cross-artifact refusal never claims one artifact, and it carries `coOwnership`. `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` now names the declaration as the fix.

**Item 5: hydrate order** (`packages/core/src/hydration-order.ts`, new). `orderHydrationBatch` sorts a batch with `resolvePluginOrder`, using declared ids as optional edges. This is the reading `resolveArtifactPackageEntries` already gives the key; there is no second sorter. A node lists every package id it carries. A cycle's internal edges are dropped before sorting, found with Tarjan's algorithm, so its members keep source order while still following their acyclic dependencies. The cycles are returned for the caller to log, and nothing throws. Both hydrates use it:

- the `sys_packages` hydrate in `packages/services/service-package/src/index.ts`, where one row is one node;
- the install-local `kernel:ready` rehydrate in `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts#inDependencyOrder`, where one ledger entry is one node. A declared id resolves to the entry that carries that package, and an id declared between packages of one entry is no edge.

`declaredDependencyIds` (`packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts`) is the one record-only reading of `manifest.dependencies` that the registry and both hydrates share.

**Review notes from #25986:**

- An undecided union whose installed version is readable (`<5 || latest` against `7.0.0`) now reports `found: 'unreadable-range'` instead of naming the version.
- Install-local no longer counts the artifact wrapper's own id as delivered. `DeclaredDependencyCheck.deliveredIds`, which had no other caller, is removed.

**Docs:**

- `content/docs/deployment/app-dependencies.mdx` now says that two modules of one app need not declare each other. It also explains namespace co-ownership by declaration and its object-name rule, the companion precondition, and the boot order with its cycle log.
- The `plugin-spec.mdx` consumer callout now names five consumers.

## Declarations

`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`. The widening: install acceptance (packages previously refused `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` now install) and new `@objectstack/core` exports (`orderHydrationBatch`, `declaredDependencyIds`, `HydrationNode`, `HydrationOrder`). The narrowing: install-local refuses a module that declares only its artifact wrapper's id, and the `deliveredIds` option is removed. Both of those belong to the D2 check, which #25986 landed and which is still unreleased (its changeset is pending on main). The changeset is `patch`, with a BREAKING banner and an ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker.

`Metadata-protocol: none`. No key, accepted value or metadata type changes in what an author can write.

## Tests

Red first: each new suite failed on main before its wiring.

| Suite | Before the fix | After the fix |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `packages/objectql/src/registry-artifact-co-ownership.test.ts`, new describe extending the ADR-0130 D3 gate test, real load path through `manifest.register()`; the sixth case is a negative control | 5 failed, 10 passed | 15 passed |
| `packages/services/service-package/src/hydration-dependency-order.test.ts`, real `SchemaRegistry` | 2 failed | 2 passed |
| `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-rehydrate-order.test.ts` | 2 failed | 2 passed |
| `packages/core/src/hydration-order.test.ts` | new sorter | 6 passed |
| the review-note cases in `protocol-handshake-dependencies.test.ts` and `marketplace-install-local-dependency-missing.test.ts` | 1 failed each | passed |

The new objectql cases cover:

- the cross-artifact pair: the dependent is admitted, and a dependent defining `crm_account` is refused;
- the sibling pair: the sibling is admitted, and a sibling defining the other sibling's name is refused;
- the parent arriving second;
- the upgrade case: the parent is admitted, and a parent newly defining the module's name is refused naming the module;
- an undeclared sharer, which is still refused;
- siblings whose parent is absent or holds another namespace, which are refused.

Every refusal asserts `code` and `status`.

| Package | Test files | Tests |

| core | 120 | 2774 |
| objectql | 470 | 8748 |

| Mutation | Failures |
|:---|:---|
| parent arm removed | 3 |
| reverse arm disabled | 2 (either end, upgrade) |
| sibling arm removed | 1 |
| sibling arm reading any shared declared id instead of an installed parent holding N | 1 |

| cycle edges kept | 1 |

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` accounts for all 106 derived families, all exit 0. One found a real miss: `check-registry-log-declared` flagged the service-package suite that now builds a `SchemaRegistry`, and `vitest.config.ts` now declares `OS_REGISTRY_LOG`. Scoped `eslint` on the touched files exits 0, and `check:nul-bytes` exits 0.

Full dogfood on `968c670094`: 2522 passed, 18 skipped, 1 failed (VERDICT command-exit 1). The head `10c01a4181` adds only the service-package `vitest.config.ts` env line. The failure is `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts`, the `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts` row (`handleI18nRequest` expected 3, got 4). That is main's red since #25956, reported on #25986 too; this PR touches neither file.

## Acceptance notes

- With #25986, this completes card items 1, 2, 4, 5 and 7. Item 3 has no `ui/**` edit, and item 6 is #26000.
- HotCRM precondition (ADR-0141 D5, Open items 7): at hotcrm `d91c7b0`, every `crm` companion (service, marketing, revenue) declares `app.objectstack.hotcrm`, so the sibling arm admits each of them beside the app and beside each other.
- First reading 2, from the code and not instrumented on a booted stack: ObjectQLPlugin's `kernel:ready` seals and the ledger rehydrate both run on `kernel:ready`, in hook-registration order. The install-local plugin declares no ordering edge against ObjectQLPlugin. One cross-path case stays unordered by design (ADR-0141 Open items 2): two siblings in `sys_packages` whose parent hydrates later from the ledger.
- `Fixes #25792` is for the seat to judge. This body says `Part of` because item 6 is filed separately.
